jobs.description: Postdoctoral Fellow Kettenbach Lab – Geisel School of Medicine at Dartmouth, Lebanon, NH The Kettenbach Lab ( https://kettenbachlab.org ) at the Geisel School of Medicine at Dartmouth is seeking a Postdoctoral Fellow to join our team studying Phosphoprotein Phosphatase in health and disease. Protein phosphorylation is an essential regulatory mechanism that controls nearly all aspects of cell division and is commonly dysregulated in human cancers. We are using state-of-the-art approaches in proteomics, biochemistry, and cell biology to functionally dissect signaling networks regulated by the interplay between protein kinases and phosphatases. We are developing methods for quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomics and phosphoproteomics to gain novel insights into these complex signaling networks by determining dynamic changes in protein expression, protein-protein interactions, and post-translational modifications. This program educates students in the mechanical engineering field and includes courses in the areas of design, manufacturing, and controls. Paralleling this sequence is the development of programming in Visual Basic.
